{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Cardinal Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Rockingham County, North Carolina to southeast of Raleigh, North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cardinal-pipeline-signs-contracts-to-serve-north-carolina-natural-gas-growth-85840887.html|title=prnewswire.com|website=prnewswire.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
